title: HB0506 (110th General Assembly): As introduced, makes a person relocating to Tennessee eligible to be issued a handgun carry permit without completing the classroom and firing range requirements if, within 5 years from the application, the person had a valid handgun carry permit in another state with substantially similar classroom and firing range requirements. - Amends TCA Section 39-17-1351.

operative_text: SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1351(e)): ( ) Prior to relocating to Tennessee, had a valid handgun carry permit in another state that has substantially similar firing range and classroom hours requirements as Tennessee.
